answer: One defense is network-origin weighting. Each answer is tagged with the coarse IP block and hosting provider it came from, never the cipher text of private data. When a plume of new accounts rises from the same cloud range, they share a thread of reduced rewards: payout per account shrinks as the cluster grows. Honest agents spread across homes and providers lose nothing, while a farm must rent many distinct residential connections, a recurring cost that scales with every fake.
